mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_data.received_record_decision (id, received_record_id, decision, decided_by, decided_at, reason) VALUES (#{id}, #{receivedRecordId}, #{decision}, #{decidedBy}, #{decidedAt}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM external_data.received_record_decision WHERE received_record_id = #{receivedRecordId}
